name: Ambulance Transport Information
sourceRefs: PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 837.5010.X222.A1.xml — new segment for Phase 2. CR1 reuses data element 355 (Unit or Basis for Measurement Code) TWICE at different positions (01: patient weight's own unit, valid_codes LB; 05: transport distance's own unit, valid_codes DH) — kept as two independently-named fields since they're genuinely different business values, not the same field repeated. CR103 (Ambulance Transport Code), CR107/08 (both Address Information) are usage=N at the real occurrence — dropped.
